## Objective
- Rebuild and refine the zombie-survival browser game into a polished, playable first-person 3D experience with improved lighting, environments, enemies, combat effects, audio, and movement.

## Requirements
- Retain the 30-floor building, seven-room layout, six survivor rescues, zombie combat, rooftop helicopter extraction, and desktop/mobile controls.
- Improve graphics from simple low-poly primitives to a richer polygon style.
- Add stronger lighting, lamps, furniture, and more detailed environments.
- Create complex zombie models.
- Add sound effects and a visible firing animation.
- Improve movement smoothness and responsiveness.

## Decisions
- Keep Three.js loaded from jsDelivr through an import map without package installation.
- Use the dark lobby for floor 1 and office-style rooms on later floors.
- Preserve the static-server/browser workflow at `http://127.0.0.1:4173`.

### Completed
- Replaced the 2D canvas engine with a first-person Three.js implementation.
- Added 30-floor progression, seven rooms, survivor rescues, zombies, ammo pickups, health, reloads, stair progression, and rooftop extraction.
- Added pointer-lock aiming, keyboard movement, shooting, mobile controls, and touch look.

- Fixed the mobile `preventEvent` typo to `preventDefault()`.
- Fixed pickup animation indexing.
- Disabled pointer lock on mobile and prevented canvas touch scrolling.
- Confirmed `game.js` passes `node --check`.
- Confirmed the static server serves `index.html` and `game.js` successfully.

### Active
- Upgrading the visual and gameplay presentation requested after the initial implementation.
- The active changes are not yet applied.

### Blocked
- None reported.

## Next Move
1. Improve scene brightness with stronger ambient, hemisphere, and room lighting.
2. Add denser floor decoration, lamps, furniture, emergency props, and varied room surfaces.
3. Replace primitive zombies with articulated low-poly models with separate limbs, heads, clothing, wounds, and animation.
4. Add procedural Web Audio gunshots, reloads, pickup, zombie attack, and interaction sounds.
5. Add muzzle flash, firing recoil, and an animated weapon or muzzle-effect.
6. Replace direct movement with normalized, smoothed acceleration/deceleration, sprinting, and improved head bobbing.
7. Browser-test desktop and mobile rendering and gameplay after the upgrades.
